items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I know Duke well. I met Duke in Omaha. He was just singing then.

ctx.x: You've always gotten a very beautiful dark sound on string bass. And I've noticed other bass players that have come out of Chicago have this dark tone. I'm now speaking of the sound of the tone. Did you strive for that, or do you feel that was just -- came out naturally
the way you played? William (Wellman) Braud was sponsoring me playing like I'm playing. Used to be with Duke. Duke's first bass player.
